text: Senate Concurrent Resolution 104 - Introduced SENATE CONCURRENT RESOLUTION NO. 104 BY KLIMESH A Concurrent Resolution to provide for adjournment sine 1 die. 2 BE IT RESOLVED BY THE SENATE, THE HOUSE OF 3 REPRESENTATIVES CONCURRING, That when adjournment is 4 had on Friday, October 2, 2026, it shall be the final 5 adjournment of the 2026 First Extraordinary Session of 6 the Ninety-first General Assembly. 7 -1- LSB 6978XS (3) 91 jm/jh 1/ 1
